summary: The industry that employs the most young workers is leisure and hospitality, which includes food service.
realLife: Of 21.32 million employed 16- to 24-year-olds in July 2026, 5.3 million worked in leisure and hospitality, about a quarter.
sources: Bureau of Labor Statistics, Table 3: Employed people 16 to 24 by industry, July 2025-2026: https://www.bls.gov/news.release/youth.t03.htm
inGame: the employer organization on the hire row (kind of business). needs: employer industry on the hire row.
